name: labs/accelerationconsortium__opentrons-flex
title: Opentrons Flex motion controller (FlexMotionController)
intro: Opentrons Flex motion controller (FlexMotionController), adapted from accelerationconsortium/opentrons-flex. It reads `simulating` and `machine_status`; sets `lights_button` and `lights_rails`; runs `home`, `cartesian_pose` and `stop`. `home`: home every Flex axis with FlexMotionController.home(); the declared re-enable: after a halt or an e-stop the connector refuses every other actuation until this full home completes. The latch refuses it and a safety reset never runs it. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
